summary: Sprint verification for Fyers multi-account isolation bug fix (A=Dimple, B=Rupesh crossover). Static/harness verification per PRD (no DB in pod). Build clean, both node harnesses print 'RESULT: ALL PASS', all 43 pytest cases pass. Reported crossover bug is fixed; no regressions to Sprint 6.2.13 reconnect flow or to other brokers.
critical_code_review_comments: fyers.adapter.ts still keeps env-based defaults for appId/secretId (lines 67-68) for back-compat. Harness proves the auth flow never uses them (env set to decoy 'ENVLEAK-APP' and never leaks), but consider removing the env defaults entirely in a follow-up to eliminate the last remaining foot-gun.

buildAccountAdapter in fyers.controller.ts correctly decrypts encryptedApiKey/encryptedApiSecret per account and calls setCredentials before every getLoginUrl / exchangeToken / getProfile call — matches the ICICI pattern as mandated.

broker.service.ts rename iciciCreds -> accountApiCreds now covers both ICICI_DIRECT and FYERS; FYERS branch calls setCredentials(apiKey, apiSecret) before setAccessToken so dashboard reads are also isolated.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verification model for this repo is STATIC (no Postgres/Redis in pod). Steps: (1) pnpm --filter @cts/api build, (2) node backend/tests/fyers_account_isolation_harness.cjs, (3) node backend/tests/fyers_reconnect_harness.cjs, (4) pytest backend/tests/test_fyers_account_isolation.py backend/tests/test_fyers_reconnect.py -q. Booting apps/api/dist/main.js will crash at PrismaModule on missing DATABASE_URL — that is EXPECTED, not a failure. Do NOT attempt live HTTP tests.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause (confirmed by user + fix): FyersAdapter previously used process.env.FYERS_APP_ID / FYERS_SECRET_ID in constructor, getLoginUrl and exchangeToken. Since Fyers auth header is `appId:accessToken`, every Fyers TradingAccount resolved to whichever broker user owned the env App ID (Dimple), regardless of which account the user was reconnecting. Fix: adapter gained instance fields appId/secretId + setCredentials(); FyersController removed its shared adapter and now builds a per-account adapter (buildAccountAdapter) that decrypts encryptedApiKey/encryptedApiSecret and calls setCredentials before each SDK call — mirroring the ICICI pattern. broker.service.ts buildAdapter FYERS branch does the same for dashboard reads. Verified by 20-assertion isolation harness (env set to decoy 'ENVLEAK-APP' to trap any global leak; A->B->A->B->B->A switching never crosses profiles; two independent BrokerSession rows coexist by (tradingAccountId, broker) composite key).
